android.releaseNotes:
• Rectangular Squircle Liquid Indicator: Transformed indicator into a smooth rounded rectangular squircle spanning item slots.
• Expanded Pill Layout: Enhanced bottom navbar pill width responsively across mobile and desktop displays.
• Bottom Screen Anchoring: Fixed vertical layout centering bug to anchor the pill and progressive blur firmly at the bottom of the screen.
